verdict.rationale: Pipeline CRM documents a REST API with an OpenAPI spec that covers core objects (deals, people, companies, activities, calendar entries, documents) and supports creating, changing and deleting records. Nothing in the evidence claims or shows that the API matches the UI, and many UI features have no evidenced API equivalent. missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity claim, API coverage of pipeline/stage and custom-field configuration, calling, campaigns, e-signature, forms, reports/dashboards and Copilot actions, and independent or hands-on corroboration of API breadth.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
